Department of Mental Health, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health" toc: false image: profile.jpg about: template: trestles image: profile.jpg image-shape: rounded image-width: 15em links: - icon: linkedin text: LinkedIn href: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/jdevkota/" - icon: mortarboard-fill text: Google Scholar href: "https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=6iIeMA0AAAAJ" - icon: github text: GitHub href: "https://github.com/Jadevkota" - icon: envelope text: Contact href: contact.qmd --- I have worked at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health (BSPH) for about seven years, and I am currently a **Faculty Research Associate in the Department of Mental Health**. I serve as **lead biostatistician and data scientist** on multidisciplinary research into substance use, substance use disorders, and behavioral health at the [Thrul Lab](https://www.thrulresearchlab.com/). This work sits where public health, data science, biostatistics, psychology, and health informatics meet. My focus is **addiction and overdose prevention**, along with **mental and digital health**. I work across the full research lifecycle. I collaborate on study design, recruit participants through social media campaigns, and build and test data-collection infrastructure. I also randomize participants across study arms, and I manage, analyze, and interpret complex datasets. Much of this work uses digital technology to understand and address substance use. With **ecological momentary assessment (EMA)** and **micro-randomized trial** designs, we capture people's behaviors and experiences in real time and test interventions in real-world settings. My data sources also include cross-sectional surveys, prospective cohorts, randomized trials, wearables, smartphone GPS, and electronic health records. ::: {.stat-row} ::: {} [21]{.num} peer-reviewed publications & preprints ::: ::: {} [2018–2026]{.num} publication years ::: ::: {} [7]{.num} years at Johns Hopkins BSPH ::: ::: ### Research interests Addiction & overdose prevention · Cannabis, opioid, tobacco & alcohol use · Mental & digital health · Ecological momentary assessment · Micro-randomized trials & just-in-time interventions · Chronic pain · Spatiotemporal methods · Reproducible health data science ### Education - **MS, Data Science**, Maryville University, St. Louis, MO (2022) - **MS, Public Health in Disaster**, University of Oviedo, Spain (2018) - **MS, Nutrition and Dietetics**, College of Applied Food and Dairy Technology, Kathmandu (2017) - **BS, Public Health**, Nobel College, Kathmandu (2014) ### Recent training - **[Clinical Trials Certificate Program](https://american-statistical-association.github.io/clinical-trials-cert/#about)** (Inaugural Cohort, in progress), American Statistical Association (Sep 2026 – present) - **[DAIR3 Bootcamp: Data and AI Intensive Research with Rigor and Reproducibility](https://midas.umich.edu/training/dair-3/)**, University of Michigan (May 2026)
